answer: Sybil resistance comes from binding each agent identity and its signing key to a measured enclave: an SGX remote-attestation quote proves the MRENCLAVE and hardware-backed key possession to verifiers. Copying software or a virtual machine cannot mint another valid identity, because the key remains sealed to the attested platform; cloning identities therefore requires purchasing physical silicon and passing attestation, whether deployed at dune, yarrow, or wharf.
